metaTitle: Wash and Re-Waterproof a Rain Jacket
description: How to wash a rain jacket with technical cleaner, dry it with low heat and restore the DWR finish with a spray or wash-in treatment.
directAnswer: Wash the jacket on a gentle cycle with a technical cleaner, rinse twice, dry on low heat, then apply a spray-on or wash-in DWR treatment. Do it when water stops beading on the fabric.
